verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a broad API. It covers campaign creation, event tracking, webhook management and data pull for reporting, and an official MCP server supports campaign creation and flow performance reports. However, nothing in the evidence claims UI–API parity. UI capabilities such as building flows/automations, segmentation and drag-and-drop template editing have no documented API equivalents here. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, documented API endpoints for creating flows, segments and templates, and independent corroboration that UI actions are fully scriptable.
